sara-sales: FYI AltronCare (EU payer) requested a consolidated POC evidence package. They asked for: SOC 2 Type II excerpts, ISO 27001 cert, network diagram (EU region), signed pen-test attestation, short data-deletion policy excerpt, encryption-in-transit confirmation, and pricing note for Dedicated vs Private. POC kickoff target Jul 15. Can someone own and confirm ETA? @mona-security? :eyes:

kevin-ae: Clarifying q: full SOC2 or excerpts/control matrix only? Also ask if they need the testers permission to share redacted third-party report or if a company-signed attestation suffices. I'll ping the PO.

mona-security: I can own the pack. Plan: SOC2 Type II control excerpts (redacted for vendor contacts), ISO cert copy, EU network diagram, data-deletion policy excerpt (30-day retention for POC logs), and a short note confirming TLS 1.2+ in transit. For pen-test: we have a standard attestation template stating "no critical findings as of [scan date]". Legal sign-off needed for signature. ETA: 3 business days after scope + recipient confirmed.

storage-bot: Proofpack workspace initialized: s3://proofpacks/altroncare/4448887776/
Presign (48h): curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood/proofpacks/4448887776?sig=upload_token_example" -F file=@evidence.zip :lock:

alex-infra: We can provide 3 static IPs for external scans and optionally a short-lived VPC peering for internal assessment. Dedicated during POC adds approx +$7k/mo. Private requires project kickoff (~10 business days) and a one-time onboarding fee (~$13k). If they want KMS/HSM split notes for Private, we can include a high-level diagram. IPs available within 24h after owner assigned.

tori-legal: We can provide a signed pen-test attestation on letterhead. Need recipient name, exact wording they expect ("no critical findings" vs "no critical or high findings"), and confirmation the NDA permits signed artifacts. If they request a redacted third-party report we must obtain vendor permission which could add time. Typical turnaround for signed attestation: draft same day, signature next business day.

sara-sales: Target delivery to customer by Jul 8 so they can review before Jul 15 kickoff. Kevin please confirm Type II vs Type I and tester-permission ask with PO today. Mona please own artifacts and upload to proofpack. Alex please hold the /29 and add IP list once owner assigned. Tori I'll DM recipient info if they want signed letter.

kevin-ae: Pinged PO. They prefer Type II excerpts and said a company-signed attestation is fine, but they'd like a short CVE->remediation note from the last test. Will confirm exact attestation phrasing and recipient email by EOD. :thumbsup:

mona-security: Acknowledged. I'll prepare SOC2 excerpts, ISO cert, EU network diagram, data-deletion excerpt, TLS confirmation blurb, and a CVE->remediation summary. Will post draft attestation for legal review once KEVIN shares phrasing/recipient.

tori-legal: Ack. Once draft posted include recipient email and I'll route for GC signature. If they ask for stronger language tying remediation SLAs to contractual obligations, flag Sales.

alex-infra: Placeholder IPs reserved. Will supply concrete addresses after owner assigned and add manifest to proofpack.
